title: Log in
heading: Contributor account
keepSession: Keep this session open on this device
nationalAccess: Sign in with the National Single Sign-On
browseOnly: Or browse the archive without signing in

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.heading: Choose a new password
setPassword.hint: Your account was created with a temporary password. For security, pick a new one before continuing.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.hint: Enter the email address you sign in with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account uses this address, a link to choose a new password is on its way:
forgotPassword.sentHint: The link works once and expires after a while. If nothing arrives within a few minutes, check your spam folder or try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.hint: Use at least 8 characters. You'll sign in with this password from now on.
resetPassword.invalidBody: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Each link works only once, so request a new one to continue.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.

brand.heading: An open archive of Saudi art history
brand.body: A contributor account lets you document artists, artworks, and archival materials, attach sources, and track what each record still needs before approval.
